entries.title: Startup fix + faster startup + reasoning-level fitting
bullets: Fixed a blank startup page, an unresponsive "Start DSHA" button, and occasional stalls on the recovery page after upgrading.
Faster startup: the plugin-link verification stage dropped from about 64 seconds to 0.4 seconds, removing the timeout that could keep the app from starting.

Added automatic reasoning-level fitting: declares the reasoning levels a model offers when the profile does not declare them (DSHA never guesses what a third-party model supports — an undeclared model shows no reasoning row). Only adds, never overwrites, and backs up the profile first.
The application icon is now tappable and offers six color schemes that apply immediately and are remembered.
Added a native dependency check to the plugin capability summary: reads the ABI and file headers of bundled native modules and warns without blocking installation.
Added an update log panel: the About page lists entries per version with an expand action.
Added an upstream comparison: reports whether the code matches upstream, read-only.
The About page contact entry now points to the maintainer profile and the issue tracker.

Merged upstream v0.2.1-rc.2 (build190): DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and mobile UI 3.2.1, experimental virtual display and global confirmation policy, plugin Safe Mode, plugin management and sign-in/LAN/keyboard/background recovery fixes, one-tap backup and export.

entries.title: Plugin install transaction safety + icon consistency gate
bullets: Fixed plugin installs falsely reporting failure on f2fs file systems.
Added an icon consistency check guarding the icon, alias order, and version numbers hardcoded in UI strings.
Fixed the update log block rendering as nothing.

entries.title: Six color schemes finalized + icon fills the canvas
bullets: The six color schemes are finalized, correcting the near-duplicate "Ink Jade" and renaming "Snow Jade" to Sky Blue.
The kun icon now spans 88.67% of the canvas instead of 80.66%, with no clipping under circular or rounded-rectangle masks.
Fixed launcher icon background colors that did not match the design.

entries.title: Kun icon rework + six switchable color schemes
bullets: The application icon is now the kun silhouette alone, without the double jade ring or gilded outline. The motif comes from Zhuangzi, "Free and Easy Wandering": there is a fish in the Northern Darkness, its name is Kun, and Kun is so vast that no one knows how many thousand li it spans.
Six color schemes are switchable from "Settings → About DSHA" by tapping the icon at the top of the page.
DSHA is now documented as short for DSH-Android.

entries.title: Independent package name (first release)
bullets: The application ID is now dsh.android.dev, a separate app from upstream with no shared data and no cross-install; migration uses a backup export/restore.
The app is named DSHA, short for DSH-Android.
